title: Correlated sign vector measure
statement: For a real parameter $\rho\in[-1,1]$, the correlated sign vector measure is the probability distribution on the correlation plane obtained by mapping a sign pair drawn according to the correlated sign-pair law with parameter $\rho$ to the vector of its two real sign values.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the correlated sign-pair law, so its precise probabilities cannot be stated from this payload alone.
